text:
anya: Heads-up — SDK docs freeze in ~48h for v1.12.0 release. Quick checklist below; need owners for regen, changelog, and deploy. Tagging @sam @jia @lee.

sam: On it. I'll run the SDK docs regen tonight. Which PRs should I include for the version bump?

jia: Changelog PR #4823 is ready (drafted entries + links). Needs a changelog review from @lee before merge.

lee: Looking now, tiny wording nit in the network section. Will post an inline and approve after fix.

sam: Regen workflow I'm planning: `./scripts/regenerate-sdk-docs.sh --target v1.12.0` then push branch `docs/sdk/regenerate-v1.12`. If anyone needs to add examples, speak now.

deploy-bot: Canary build queued — build-9876 (staging). ETA ~10m. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9876

mike: Who's got permissions to publish prod docs? I can run the prod deploy but prefer @anya to trigger after canary sign-off.

anya: Correct — I'll trigger prod deploy. Plan: regen tonight, canary deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT, prod deploy 11:00 PT if canary is green and changelog is merged.

sam: Canary finished and looks clean from the SDK side — https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/canary/build-9876 :thumbsup:

lee: Changelog PR updated per comments, approved. @jia please merge and bump the release branch.

jia: Merged PR #4823 and pushed tag `v1.12.0` to `release/v1.12`. Also opened version-bump PR #4830 for SDK packages (needs one more approval).

anya: Great — final asks: if you made API surface changes, drop a one-line note here. If none, I'll trigger prod at 11:00 PT. :rocket:

mike: No API surface changes from infra. I'll be on-call for rollback if anything odd shows up.

sam: Pushed `docs/sdk/regenerate-v1.12` branch with regenerated examples and crosslinks. PR #4835 created for docs site changes.

anya: Thanks everyone. I'll watch the canary metrics at 09:00 PT and post status. If anything blocks, ping me directly.
